description.zh: 绑定SSH密钥对的实例ID。取值可以由多台实例ID组成一个JSON数组，最多支持50个ID，ID之间用半角逗号（,）隔开。
description.en: The IDs of the instances to which you want to bind the SSH key pair. The value can be a JSON array that consists of up to 50 instance IDs. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,).
The name of the SSH key pair.

description.zh: SSH密钥对所在的地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~25609~~)查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
description.en: The region ID of the SSH key pair. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list of Alibaba Cloud.

title.en: Bind a key pair to Linux instances

descriptions.zh:
当您使用该接口时，需要注意：

-  Windows实例不支持SSH密钥对。 
-  绑定SSH密钥对后，将禁用用户名加密码的验证方式。 
-  如果实例处于**运行中**（Running）状态，重启实例（[RebootInstance](~~25502~~)）后，SSH密钥对生效。  
-  如果实例处于**已停止**（Stopped）状态，启动实例（[StartInstance](~~25500~~)）后，SSH密钥对生效。  
-  如果实例已经绑定了SSH密钥对，新的SSH密钥对自动替换原来的SSH密钥对。
descriptions.en:
When you call this operation, take note of the following items:

- Windows instances do not support SSH key pairs.
- After you bind an SSH key pair to an instance, authentication by using a username and password is disabled.
- If the instance is in the **Running** state, restart the instance ([RebootInstance](~~25502~~)) for the SSH key pair to take effect.
- If the instance is in the **Stopped** state, start the instance ([StartInstance](~~25500~~)) for the SSH key pair to take effect.
- If an SSH key pair is already bound to the instance, the new SSH key pair automatically replaces the original one.
